text:
anya: Follow-up from the tracing/attribution convo. New wrinkle: multi-hop proxies + tenant-level shard failover can drop the cost signal when we do head-only sampling. We need a robust small handshake that survives sampling and is cheap on common paths.

marcos: Can we keep it to one header+light deltas? Anything bulk will blow up ingress costs.

anya: Proposal: "budget_handshake" at envelope root (string decimal), plus optional span field "c" (consumed, string). Only the edge ingress writes budget_handshake. Subsequent services add spans with c present if they actually consume tokens. Sampler invariant: if budget_handshake exists, sampled output must include it on the root.

devon: How to handle failed/multi- ingress scenarios? Two ingresses could both set handshake if routing changes. What's the canonical rule?

anya: Rule: first-writer wins. Each ingress includes an ingress_id; aggregator dedups by trace_id and picks the smallest ingress_id (lexicographic) as origin_budget. We'll document as: ingress SHOULD attempt to write iff no origin present; if it sees an origin, it leaves it. Collector will accept both but reconciliation picks canonical origin.

sara: Cache hits: we currently emit tiny pings for fast-path hits. Suggestion: fast-path keep no c field (implicitly zero). When a fill happens, emit an async span with c>0. That way hot hits stay small.

marcos: Sampler whitelist: force-sample traces where any span reports c > threshold T (config). But if we only see c on non-sampled spans we still need origin_budget on head to reconcile later.

devon: Aggregator logic? How do we avoid double-counts from retries and backfill?

anya: Aggregation pseudo: 
```
-- per trace reconciliation
WITH attrs AS (
  SELECT trace_id, min(origin_budget) AS origin_budget
  FROM envelopes
  GROUP BY trace_id
), consumed AS (
  SELECT trace_id, sum(cast(c AS numeric)) AS total_consumed
  FROM spans
  GROUP BY trace_id
)
SELECT a.trace_id, a.origin_budget,
       coalesce(least(a.origin_budget::numeric, coalesce(consumed.total_consumed,0)),0) AS reconciled_cost
FROM attrs a
LEFT JOIN consumed ON a.trace_id = consumed.trace_id;
```
Note: origin_budget stored as text to avoid float round trips on agent libs. Convert at aggregator time.

marcos: Backfill behavior: for tenants that opt-in mid-rollout we can run a backfill that applies route-model heuristics to historical traces that lack c but had origin_budget. We'll store a confidence tag.

sara: Ops: rollout flags per-region/tenant. Phase 0 collectors accept handshake but ignore in billing. Phase 1 enable reconciled_cost in staging and validate; Phase 2 small cohort prod; Phase 3 broader enable. Add a kill-switch per-region.

devon: Tests: ingress-first-writer wins, duplicate ingress conflict, cache-fill attribution, sampler-not-dropping-origin, forced-sample threshold behavior, and aggregator numeric edgecases (string parse failures).

anya: Security: only numeric small decimals and ingress_id (uuid). No request headers, no user data. Document retention and masking in exports.

obs-bot: Created ticket OBS-932: multi-hop budget handshake tests + RFC addendum.

anya: I'll draft an RFC addendum with the envelope schema, ingress rules, sampler invariant, aggregator SQL, rollout checklist and the test matrix. Will tag owners (marcos/devon/sara) for review.
